master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE1 is authoritative geometry, IMAGE2 is painting style ONLY. Render Level06 as hand-painted side-scrolling ancient forest environment, wide 2048x768 canvas, 8:3. Trace the GREEN fixed terrain from IMAGE1, including every upper step and recess and the exact central pit width. Keep full framing/upper sky band, bottom aligned. Two large terrain banks separated by ONE open central pit. Left bank starts low, drops into a shallow square recess, rises to a broad flat terrace. Right bank starts at the SAME terrace height, extends into a small lip above a lower shallow recess, then rises to the tall exit at far right. Keep the SMALL beige horizontal floating FIXED slab above the central pit at the same x/y/width. Do NOT put any supporting column through the pit. Tiny angled braces under the slab are okay.
The two very tall vertical beige rods and both pressure-plate bases and blue dashed boxes are INTERACTIVE: REMOVE all of them, leaving broad terrace tops unobstructed. No posts, cubes, machinery or stone substitutes in their places. Replace yellow exit outline only with a modest empty mossy stone arch, no door/seal. Pit remains completely open to the bottom edge, no bridge or floor joining it.
Distinct scenery: tranquil beech grove, two monumental ancient tree trunks framing a bright central glade, soft green canopies, a few distant rounded ruin fragments with minimal tall architecture, deep turquoise forest atmosphere, low dry mossy boulders far behind the action. Broad sunlit terraces evoke a peaceful sanctuary. Match IMAGE2 premium illustrative detail, natural stone mixed with ancient masonry, beautiful moss and thin gold-green grass tops, sparse ferns, warm sunlight from upper left. Keep platform surfaces legible, no tall plants in mechanism spaces. Corner leaves only above route. No water, static waterfall, mist sprites, particles or hanging moving strands. No text, arrows, grid, borders, characters, objects, hazards, gems, magic, plates, rods, mechanisms. Flat 2D side-view, no pixel art/3D/isometric. Preserve geometry before decoration.
static:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the exact near gameplay environment from this master image onto REAL transparent alpha. Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Do not redesign or shift anything, do not add structure, do not fill pits. Keep the sunlit thin platform tops exactly. No water, text, characters, grid, effects. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.
Keep precisely two terraced banks and the one floating fixed slab. Central pit is alpha to bottom edge. Keep small near canopy leaves at upper corners but REMOVE the huge beech tree trunks and roots behind gameplay terrain; these belong to background. Keep exit arch opening alpha. No mechanism or pressure plate.
background:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant low ruins placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions. Also remove near corner framing branches/tree trunk. The resulting image has only distant non-walkable soft painted forest and ancient atmospheric ruins. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
The huge beech tree trunks at the left and right are part of the scenic mid-background: retain those trunks and their canopy. Remove only the sharp near upper-corner framing leaves and all gameplay masonry. Keep the original tree positions; reconstruct distant ground/forest behind gameplay platforms without adding flat walkable ledges.
